details: Bitcoin experienced a notable increase alongside equities following an announcement by former U.S. President Donald Trump regarding the extension of a ceasefire with Iran. This decision is viewed as a stabilizing factor, alleviating some geopolitical tensions that have been influencing market dynamics. The cryptocurrency market, often sensitive to such developments, reacted positively, with Bitcoin leading the price appreciation. This upward trend reflects investor optimism for more stable conditions in the region.
title: US Extends Iran Ceasefire, Bitcoin Rises
